title: MoSPI Releases 'PAIMANA' Infrastructure Monitoring Dashboard (165 Indicators)
summary: Replaces OCMS-2006 to track power, civil aviation, telecom, rail, roads, and ports.

blocks.content: Replaces OCMS-2006 to track power, civil aviation, telecom, rail, roads, and ports.

items: Dashboard Scope: PAIMANA (Project Assessment, Infrastructure Monitoring & Analytics for Nation-building) tracks 165 indicators across 6 sub-sectors.
Energy Storage Forecast: India's energy storage requirement projected to rise 10x to 888 GWh by FY36 (from 87 GWh in FY28).
Teledensity: National teledensity improved to 93.26% in FY26 as mobile towers reached 8.55 lakh.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
